title: Ghar Ko Chhoda Shah Nay Jungal Basaney Kay Liye
body:
Ghar ko chhoda shah nay jungal basaney kay liye
Karbala mein aaye thay jannath may jaaney kay liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zohr ko Zainab se jab milnay gaye ghar mein Hussain
Koyi devdi par na tha parda utha nay kay liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh utthey pad kar namaaz-e-subha mehshar ho gaya
Hazrat-e-Zainab chaleen kapday pehnaaney kay liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahti thi maa qhat meray Akbar ko tha paighaam-e-marg
Yeh jawaani aayi thi goya bulaaney kay liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi sada zehra ki Zainab margaya tera Hussain
Ghar may ja beti safay matam bichaaney kay liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Aey taashuq waa-ey hasrat kuch nahin zaad-e-safar
Haath khaali baithe ho duniya se jaane ke liye
